titolo: NVIDIA releases Rust tool‑calling parsers for Nemotron and other LLM families
descr: A new NVIDIA blog details reusable Rust components that turn LLM output into structured tool‑call events, supporting recovery from malformed streams.
paragrafi: NVIDIA’s technical blog published on 19 November 2026 explains how to build tool‑calling parsers in Rust using the frontend‑crates library.
The parsers convert token IDs or decoded text from large language models into ordered reasoning, visible text, and tool‑call events for applications.
Developers can create new parsers by adapting UNIFIED.* test cases, implementing grammar for the target model, and validating results with a local conformance report.
perche: These parsers give developers a consistent way to extract tool calls from any LLM, reducing the need for custom, model‑specific code.
